title: Publishing Data with Acquire Release
goal: Synchronize shared data across threads using valid Release store and Acquire load orderings.
hints: Stores publish changes to memory and require Release ordering.
Loads observe published changes and require Acquire ordering.
explanation: Publishing data safely requires pairing a `Release` store with an `Acquire` load. The `Release` store ensures all prior writes in that thread are visible to any thread that performs an `Acquire` load on the same atomic flag. Passing `Ordering::Acquire` or `Ordering::AcqRel` to `store()`, or `Ordering::Release` or `Ordering::AcqRel` to `load()`, causes a runtime panic because those orderings are invalid for single-direction memory operations.
